title: 10-Miler Water Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > SPACE SYSTEMS COMMAND > FA2521 45 CONS LGC
description:
The purpose of this acquisition is to provide for the Space Force T-Minus 10-Miler. It requires portable water dispensing tanks for 8 hydration stations on Saturday 12 December for the 10-Mile race. This is expected to cover 3,000 participants and 1500 spectators. 

 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 

 Amendment 1: Extend due date from 27 November 2026 to 02 December 2026.
